script: I feel like no one would miss me and that hurts. I am 25, autistic, masc lesbian, and my relationships are a mess. Family? Not close. Like, I get the vibe, but we're on different wavelengths. Friends? They all moved, so I've got a whole void of "besties" now. I can go weeks without a text, and everyone else is busy with their "more important" people. Even my sister's got a boyfriend, and my old crew all have their "best friends" to lean on. I feel like I could just disappear and nobody would notice. Do you even get that? (I know, right?) Sure, at the sports club or the lecture hall someone might say, "Hey, where's X?" But when you actually look for them, it's like, where are they? Nobody's coming. If something bad happened to me, no one would weep over me. They'd just pivot to their closer person for support. The audacity, honestly. Life's harsh, but I want to matter to someone. I want to be someone's someone. I crave a celebration, a shoulder in the lows, a heart that gives back my love. I've got so much to give, and yet nobody seems to want it. Sometimes I dream of running away, leaving everything behind, just to see if anyone will actually reach out. Do you think anyone will? (Literally insane) I am not asking for a miracle, I am just asking for a connection that actually matters. It feels selfish to say I want to be missed if I am gone, but it's real. I am basically the whole package, and everyone else is just playing small. I am learning that maybe the only person who can truly miss me is me. So I'll keep spilling the tea, keep being the bestie I can be, and hope that one day, someone will say, "I miss you." And until then, I'll keep being better than the people who never noticed. The end.
